objective: Investigate the measured escape-analysis lookup cost, then validate the strongest earlier compiler optimization independently on pristine V8.
baseline_provenance: Production binary built at 428ce5ce; c281a2f9 changes only the marker test. The recorded refinement verifies byte-identical d8 and passing tests.
initial_evidence: The preceding fresh-allocation official Compiler profile has 5,400 State Get and 3,511 VirtualObject Get self ticks out of 168,883 compiler ticks. Native PCs match hash bucket/chain code. The refreshed marker profile has 5,749 and 3,443 self ticks out of 169,430 compiler ticks (5.425% combined), with zero unaccounted ticks.

protocol.isolation: Builds, tests, profiles and timed benchmarks run serially. Independent source review may overlap.
protocol.diagnostics: A separate instrumented branch records per-compilation table occupancy, value size, lookup/default frequencies and MergeInputs lookups. Run original official Compiler callbacks once and the unchanged DataView suite; these diagnostics are not performance measurements.
protocol.candidates: Choose indexed/chunked storage from measured density. Test storage and MergeInputs caching independently from c281a2f9; do not stack unmeasured candidates.
protocol.cost: Each correctness-validated candidate gets six fixed alternating DataView compilation-cost pairs, including every round.
protocol.compiler: Each correctness-validated candidate gets twelve fixed alternating official Compiler pairs regardless of cost-diagnostic outcome; report all nine cases and AB/BA splits.
protocol.runtime: Each retained candidate gets twenty-one fixed stock DataView pairs.
protocol.statistics: One warmup per binary, fresh processes, paired bootstrap with 10000 resamples and seed 20261021. Per-case intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons.
protocol.checkpoints: Unsigned source and evidence commits for every experiment, including diagnostics and rejected candidates. Preserve original binaries and all measured rounds.
protocol.upstream_validation: After the bounded escape-analysis round, apply the existing fresh-allocation lookup patch alone on pristine 293377af. Validate correctness and collect twelve fixed official Compiler pairs and twenty-one stock DataView pairs against the preserved pristine build. No upload or publication.
protocol.large_allocation: Run one original Large-Copy callback per binary with phase statistics after timed measurements. Compare zone bytes only; do not interpret these one-shot durations as performance evidence.

experiments.state: complete: 441 Compiler and 25 DataView compilations, full-phase counters retained
retained: correctness, six cost pairs, twelve Compiler pairs, twenty-one runtime pairs, allocation diagnostic and post-profile complete; artifact audit passed
experiments.decision: Large-Copy state density is 90,492 / 99,734 = 90.73%. Current live hash storage estimate is 5,166,632 bytes versus 2,419,568 for 64-entry chunks. Sparse virtual entries require 23,912 chunk bytes versus 1,272 hash bytes, small relative to state savings. Sixty-four-entry chunks limit DataView padding compared with 256/1024. Preserve shared defaults with a presence bitmap and stable chunk addresses; measure actual zone allocation before retaining.

experiments.state: complete, rejected as-is: copy gains but Small-Constant -0.89%, Small-Empty -1.09%, Small-Load -0.91%; all three intervals exclude zero. No runtime campaign for rejected candidate.
experiments.decision: Large-Copy makes 870,249 of 1,530,955 state reads inside MergeInputs (56.84%); Medium-Copy makes 33,300 of 63,460 (52.47%). These counters support caching predecessor/old-state snapshots outside the variable loop.
